subject: ggplot + brushedPoints needs xvar=xxx, yvar=yyy when aes(color=zzz)

messages.author: d1c330594e46fa88
messages.subject: ggplot + brushedPoints needs xvar=xxx, yvar=yyy when aes(color=zzz)
parts:
I noticed that
ggplot + brushedPoints needs xvar=xxx, yvar=yyy when rendering ggplot chart with aes(color=zzz). 
otherwise getting ERROR: brushedPoints: not able to automatically infer `xvar` from brush

According to doc, xvar,yvar should not be needed with ggplot?  
when ggplot without aes(color=xxx), it worked fine without xvar=xxx, yvar=yyy.

I installed the latest shiny from github.
if (!require("devtools"))
  install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("rstudio/shiny")

messages.subject: Re: ggplot + brushedPoints needs xvar=xxx, yvar=yyy when aes(color=zzz)
parts:
I found that the problem was not with aes(color=) but location of aes() in general.  I removed aes(color=) but if I put aes(x=xxx, y=yyy) outside of ggplot() or geom_point(), mouse interaction fails, as the code shown below.  If you move 'aes(x=wt, y=mpg)' into either ggplot() or geom_point(), it works. 

Also, keeping the aes() outside location but adding xvar='wt', yvar='mpg' to brushedPoints and nearPoints will fix the problem, too!

 Must be a bug?

=========================
library(ggplot2)
library(shiny)

ui <- basicPage(
  plotOutput("plot1", brush = "plot_brush", click = "plot_click", height = 250),
  verbatimTextOutput("info"),
  verbatimTextOutput("info2")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
     ggplot(mtcars) + aes(x=wt, y=mpg) + geom_point() +
      facet_grid(. ~ cyl) +
      theme_bw()
  })
  
  output$info <- renderPrint({
    brushedPoints(mtcars, input$plot_brush)
  })
  
  output$info2 <- renderPrint({
    nearPoints(mtcars, input$plot_click)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
